# API reference (generated by `scripts/gen_api_docs.py`)

Base path: `/api/v1`. Errors always use `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details" } }`.
Private routes need the HttpOnly `access_token` cookie set by login or register; without it they return 401.
Run the backend and open `/docs` for the interactive version (disabled when `APP_ENV=production`).

| Method | Path | Summary | Auth |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/health` | Health | public |
| POST | `/api/v1/auth/register` | Register | public |
| POST | `/api/v1/auth/login` | Login | public |
| POST | `/api/v1/auth/logout` | Logout | public |
| GET | `/api/v1/users/me` | Me | cookie required |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/users/me` | Delete Account | cookie required |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/users/me/password` | Change Password | cookie required |
| POST | `/api/v1/predictions` | Predict | public |
| POST | `/api/v1/assessments` | Save Assessment | cookie required |
| GET | `/api/v1/assessments` | List Assessments | cookie required |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/assessments` | Delete All | cookie required |
| GET | `/api/v1/assessments/{assessment_id}` | Get Assessment | cookie required |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/assessments/{assessment_id}` | Delete Assessment | cookie required |
| GET | `/api/v1/model/metadata` | Metadata | public |
| GET | `/api/v1/model/metrics` | Metrics | public |
| GET | `/api/v1/model/feature-importance` | Feature Importance | public |

## Request and response schemas

### AssessmentInput
- `age`: number, minimum=0.0, maximum=120.0 (required)
- `gender`: one of ['Male', 'Female', 'Other'] (required)
- `hypertension`: one of [0, 1] (required)
- `heart_disease`: one of [0, 1] (required)
- `ever_married`: one of ['Yes', 'No'] (required)
- `work_type`: one of ['Private', 'Self-employed', 'Govt_job', 'children', 'Never_worked'] (required)
- `Residence_type`: one of ['Urban', 'Rural'] (required)
- `avg_glucose_level`: number, minimum=40.0, maximum=500.0 (required)
- `bmi`: number, minimum=10.0, maximum=80.0 (required)
- `smoking_status`: one of ['never smoked', 'formerly smoked', 'smokes', 'Unknown'] (required)

### AssessmentOut
- `id`: integer (required)
- `inputs`: object (required)
- `score`: number (required)
- `threshold`: number (required)
- `category`: string (required)
- `model_version`: string (required)
- `consent_at`: string (required)
- `created_at`: string (required)

### AssessmentPage
- `items`: array (required)
- `total`: integer (required)
- `limit`: integer (required)
- `offset`: integer (required)

### Credentials
- `email`: string, maxLength=254 (required)
- `password`: string, maxLength=128 (required)

### PasswordChangeIn
- `current_password`: string, maxLength=128 (required)
- `new_password`: string, maxLength=128 (required)

### PasswordConfirmIn
- `password`: string, maxLength=128 (required)

### PredictionOut
- `category`: one of ['lower', 'moderate', 'higher'] (required)
- `probability`: any (required)
- `probability_display_supported`: boolean (required)
- `threshold`: number (required)
- `model_version`: string (required)
- `disclaimer`: string (required)

### RegisterIn
- `email`: string, maxLength=254 (required)
- `password`: string, maxLength=128 (required)

### SaveAssessmentIn
- `inputs`: any (required)
- `consent`: boolean (required)

### SavedOut
- `category`: one of ['lower', 'moderate', 'higher'] (required)
- `probability`: any (required)
- `probability_display_supported`: boolean (required)
- `threshold`: number (required)
- `model_version`: string (required)
- `disclaimer`: string (required)
- `id`: integer (required)

### UserOut
- `id`: integer (required)
- `email`: string (required)
- `created_at`: string (required)
